title: Rental Vehicle Coordination Tariff Footnote: Remainder Charge After Full Seven-Day Blocks
content:
**Footnote to the tariff.** The remainder charge of the corrected time charge on a customer-pay Rental Vehicle Coordination rental tied to a network repair depends on how many rental days remain after the full seven-day blocks: a remainder of the weekly-rate threshold of 5 days (the same in every class) or more is charged one more block rate; a remainder of two days up to fewer than 5 days is charged at the extra-day rate, never more than one class weekly rate; a remainder of a single day, or of none, is charged at the class partner daily rate per remaining day.

The remaining rental days are the rental days left over once every full seven-day block is taken out; rental days are the whole days between the pickup date and the return date, plus one where the return time as counted is later than the pickup time of day.

## Remainder bands

| Remaining rental days | Remainder charge |
|---|---|
| 0 | Nothing (no remaining day at the class partner daily rate) |
| 1 | One day at the class partner daily rate |
| 2, 3 or 4 | The remaining days at the extra-day rate, never more than one class weekly rate |
| 5 or 6 | One more block rate |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- 8 rental days leave 1 remaining day: charged at the class partner daily rate. 9 rental days leave 2: charged at the extra-day rate.
- 11 rental days leave 4 remaining days: charged at the extra-day rate. 12 rental days leave 5: charged one more block rate.
- 14 rental days leave none: no remainder charge.
- On a Full-Size Rental (weekly rate 299.00 USD) with 3 remaining days at an extra-day rate of 49.83 USD, the remainder charge is 149.49 USD, below the 299.00 USD it may never exceed.
